summary: The gate (23 tests) and Autobuild v0.5.3 (9 runner tests, plus v0.5.2's acceptance tests) are on animatedads/alchemy PR #146, which is not yet merged. Run over all 497 package directories on main on 14 Nov 2026, the gate passes 317 and fails 180: 1,109 Python files have no justification, and 148 files call Python. docs/autobuild/INSTALL_V053_WITH_CLAUDE_CODE.md is a procedure Claude Code (Haiku is enough) runs on the build host. It installs v0.5.3 with the gate in advisory mode. Switching to enforce is a separate step that only Tom Dyer takes. Until then, nothing is gated: write ooRexx anyway, and run the gate yourself before submitting.
title: Where the gate stands (15 Nov 2026): built and tested, not installed
